description: This is a shell script used for testing Git's send-pack functionality, including setups for various test scenarios and the execution of test cases to verify behavior of Git push and receive-pack operations.

methods.name: rewound_push_setup
methods.description: Sets up a repository with a pushed commit history and then rewinds the head, used for testing push scenarios involving rewound history.

methods.name: extract_ref_advertisement
methods.description: Parses and extracts reference advertisement lines from the trace of Git pack operations, identifying references sent in the push protocol.
